author: Partner Threat Feed
attributes.description: Identifies processes started from binaries whose SHA-256 hash matches a Slate Funnel banking trojan sample, as reported in campaign PTF-00095. The indicators are synthetic and use reserved address and domain ranges, so they match no real traffic.
false_positives: Security testing that replays known indicators.
A shared hosting address or domain that later served benign content.
attributes.name: Slate Funnel Banking Trojan: Process started from known malicious binary (PTF-00095)
attributes.note:
## Triage and analysis

### Investigating Slate Funnel Banking Trojan: Process started from known malicious binary

This rule matches indicators that the Partner Threat Feed attributes to the Slate Funnel banking trojan in campaign PTF-00095.

### Possible investigation steps

- Review the matching event and the host or user it came from.
- Look for other indicators from the same campaign on the same host.
- Check the process tree around the event for the initial execution or delivery.

### Response and remediation

- Isolate the host if the match is confirmed.
- Block the indicators at the network edge and on endpoints.
- Reset credentials used on the host.
attributes.query: process where event.type == "start" and process.hash.sha256 in ("ceff9a45a7eff4b4a43dbd22c8408dc319a3859ee0d2db595eb0217e438a5114", "b0a63d39be639fbdbb786edc0e8a45edc0a509b10c2ce8bef6b5264c7125ed99", "e5a9a1f4b13e570da32c2c6436be120b51a89c187a6ee8fb3bf7f7e45c2182a1", "add68d97431563838668cbc7a9d4d77c0bc0869140f3457d4c4c4d2a141d67fd", "6551d7e787e11b586c01f5a0713e2263586da97eb6d5ef1beb1d54e58524f8e2")
